title: Runtime V7 First-Turn Intro Live Probe Pack
description: Focused live scenarios for the Runtime V7 first-turn welcome/intake intro. The same pack can be used by the harness live runner for prompt/tool artifacts and by the endpoint probe for customer-visible bubble assertions.
recommended_harness_command: $env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; $env:PYTHONUTF8='1'; python scripts/runtime_v7_live_test_pack.py --pack test_packs/runtime_v7_first_turn_intro_live_pack.json --mode live --scenario ft01_vague_greeting_full_intro --memory-generator heuristic --background-signal-generator hybrid-live --image-evidence-generator none --max-model-calls-per-run 20
global_review_checklist: No post-response stripping or mutation is used to remove model greetings.
Runtime-owned intro bubbles appear only when there is no prior outbound assistant, human-agent, or ManyChat automation evidence.
For every nonempty first turn, the model writes the complete personalized opening before any guided or deterministic surface.
Customer-visible bubbles do not duplicate Welcome to Gulong.ph.
The prompt asks first-turn openings to identify Gulong.ph, while the structural gate checks only that nonempty text precedes any surface.
Exact automated starter buttons provide advisory intent and route to model-owned composition rather than deterministic prose.
Seeded prior outbound history suppresses the runtime-owned first-turn intro.

scenarios.title: New customer vague greeting receives one model-owned opening

must_not_contain: Para ma-check namin yung best tires
Guide lang po: tire size usually

harness_review: turn.first_turn_intro_mode is welcome_only
turn.first_turn_opening_model_composed is true unless the bounded fixed fallback was required
context_input contains First-Turn Intro Context with mode=welcome_only
the reply welcomes or acknowledges naturally and asks one useful next question

scenarios.title: Colloquial first-turn business location question
turns: Saan po kayo located? may physical shop ba?

must_not_contain: Para ma-check namin yung best tires
Guide lang po: tire size usually

harness_review: the response directly explains the reviewed online-first setup and that the Makati head office is also an installation site instead of sounding uncertain or evasive
the approved over-100 partner brand claim may be used, but exact coverage or nearby availability still requires grounded runtime evidence
if the partner-network claim is used, it is connected to the online installation process, customer convenience, or the location next step rather than appended as a detached credential
the head-office address is correctly presented as an installation site, while pickup, stock, slots, and unreserved walk-in service are not invented
the response does not add nationwide or regional coverage without current service evidence, and any nearby-installation CTA asks for the customer's city/area rather than pivoting to unrelated intake
the opening does not prepend the unrelated full tire-intake script
